nodes.label: RAGAs (Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment)
nodes.description: A framework for reference-free evaluation of RAG pipelines, providing automated metrics to assess retrieval quality, generation faithfulness, and overall answer quality.

nodes.label: What is RAGAs?
nodes.description: Elaboration on the definition, purpose, and key innovation of RAGAs.

nodes.label: Full Form
nodes.description: Retrieval Augmented Generation Assessment.

nodes.label: Purpose
nodes.description: To evaluate RAG systems (retriever + generator) in a systematic way.

nodes.label: Key Innovation
nodes.description: Unlike traditional methods, RAGAs does not rely on human-annotated reference answers, instead using automated metrics.

nodes.label: Why RAG Evaluation is Challenging
nodes.description: Explains the complexity of evaluating RAG systems due to their hybrid nature.

nodes.label: RAG Systems Combine
nodes.description: Components that make up a RAG system.

nodes.label: Retriever
nodes.description: Finds relevant context passages.

nodes.label: Generator (LLM)
nodes.description: Produces answers using retrieved context.

nodes.label: Evaluation Must Consider
nodes.description: Key aspects that need to be assessed during RAG evaluation.

nodes.label: Retrieval Relevance
nodes.description: Did the retriever fetch the right documents?

nodes.label: Faithful Usage
nodes.description: Did the LLM correctly use the retrieved context?

nodes.label: Answer Quality
nodes.description: Is the final response coherent, accurate, and useful?

nodes.label: How RAGAs Works
nodes.description: Details the suite of metrics RAGAs introduces to cover multiple evaluation dimensions.

nodes.label: Suite of Metrics
nodes.description: Metrics introduced by RAGAs to assess different aspects of RAG performance.

nodes.label: Context Relevance
nodes.description: Measures how well retrieved passages match the query.

nodes.label: Answer Faithfulness
nodes.description: Checks if the generated answer is grounded in retrieved context.

nodes.label: Answer Quality
nodes.description: Evaluates fluency, coherence, and informativeness of the answer.

nodes.label: Reference-Free Evaluation
nodes.description: Eliminates the need for gold-standard answers, enabling faster and more scalable testing.

nodes.label: Benefits of RAGAs
nodes.description: Advantages of using the RAGAs framework for RAG pipeline evaluation.

nodes.label: Faster Evaluation Cycles
nodes.description: Critical for rapid experimentation in RAG pipelines.

nodes.label: Scalable Testing
nodes.description: Avoids costly human annotation.

nodes.label: Holistic Assessment
nodes.description: Covers retrieval, grounding, and generation quality.

nodes.label: Supports Adoption of LLMs
nodes.description: Especially important as enterprises deploy RAG for customer support, research, and domain-specific Q&A.
